get.description: Newest first, each row carries its lines. startDate and endDate are inclusive. search matches noTransaksi, client name, SPK and item/project name.

post.description: Needs outbound.create and an Idempotency-Key header (8 to 100 characters, one per draft), with the same replay rules as POST /inbound/batch: same key and payload within 24 hours returns the stored answer with the same status and header Idempotency-Replayed: true and stock is not lowered again; same key with a different payload returns 409; a missing or malformed key returns 400; a failed request stores no key. spk must be one of GET /api/v1/tracking/spk (400 otherwise) and clientName is taken from there, a clientName in the body is ignored. Lowers stock for every line in one transaction and records audit logs. If any line would push stock below 0 the whole request fails with 400 and nothing is saved. With recipientType INTERNAL, spk stores the manually entered stock/internal ID, itemName is free text, and clientName is Internal without a tracking lookup.

201.description: Outbound transaction created, or the stored answer of an earlier identical request

409.description: Idempotency-Key already used with a different payload

get.summary: Qty taken per client, SPK and item
get.description: Needs outbound.view. One row per (clientName, spk, itemId) with the summed qty of outbound lines, ordered by client, SPK and item. startDate and endDate (inclusive) filter on the transaction date. spk is a comma-separated list (max 500); omitted means every SPK. Used by Realisasi SPK and the monthly recap instead of paging through GET /outbound.

get.summary: Get one outbound transaction with its lines

put.summary: Edit an outbound transaction with an approved edit request
put.description: Needs outbound.update and an APPROVED edit request made by the caller (POST /outbound/{id}/edit-request, then a superadmin approves). Replaces date, spk, itemName, recipientType, notes and all lines. clientName is re-read from the tracking SPK and warehouseType cannot change, neither is accepted. Stock moves by the net difference per item in one transaction, 400 if any item would drop below 0, and then the approval stays APPROVED. A successful edit marks the request USED: a second PUT needs a new request. 409 without an approved request, 403 when the approval belongs to another user.

409.description: No approved edit request for this transaction. 403 (from the common errors) when the approval was made by another user

post.summary: Import outbound transactions from the export sheet
post.description: Multipart field file: one .xlsx, 10 MB at most, in the layout of GET /reports/outbound/export (header row found by its SPK column; title rows above it are skipped). Columns read by header text: Informasi Barang ("CODE - Name" as exported, or a plain name that is unique), Asal Gudang (BAHAN_BAKU, WIP or BARANG_JADI), Tujuan / Penerima (PRODUKSI or KLIEN, optionally followed by " - client", which is ignored), SPK (must exist in tracking), Tanggal, Jumlah (positive integer, at most 999999999), Pengambil and Nama Produk/Proyek (required). Lokasi and No are ignored. Rows that share Tanggal, SPK, Pengambil, Asal Gudang, Tujuan and Nama Produk/Proyek become one transaction. All or nothing: stock is checked per item over the whole file in row order, and any problem returns 400 with a row list and writes nothing. Needs outbound.create (same as POST /outbound, no separate permission). Success is 201 with the number of transactions created.

400.description: File not .xlsx, over 10 MB, unreadable, or the sheet has problems. A bad row gives errors as a list of { row, message } (Excel row number) and nothing is saved.

errors.description: Set when one or more rows are invalid

get.description: Superadmin only, 403 otherwise. Newest activity first (edit time when used, else request time). status filters the list. Each row: request (the edit request fields), outbound (the transaction header, without lines), requestedByName (the requester's username).

post.summary: Ask a superadmin to allow one edit of an outbound transaction
post.description: Needs outbound.update. Creates a PENDING request by the caller. Allowed within 24 hours of recording. One request per transaction, whatever its status: a second one is 409, including after a rejection. Returns the outbound transaction with its editRequest.

409.description: More than 24 hours since recording, or the transaction already has a request

post.description: Superadmin only, 403 otherwise. The request must be PENDING, 409 otherwise. Works after the 24-hour window. The requester can then edit the transaction once with PUT /outbound/{id}.

409.description: The request is not PENDING anymore

post.description: Superadmin only, 403 otherwise. The request must be PENDING, 409 otherwise. A rejected request cannot be re-sent: the transaction keeps its one request.

409.description: The request is not PENDING anymore

get.summary: Edit request history of one outbound transaction
get.description: Needs outbound.view. 404 for an unknown transaction. data is null when the transaction was never asked to be edited. Otherwise the request fields with requestedByName and reviewedByName (null until reviewed), and beforeValues and afterValues: the transaction header and lines before and after the edit (null until USED).
